scope: SC explicit background resource failure diagnostic. The user-reported natural scene already draws correctly with complete data; raster arithmetic, stage/commit, positions and actor/particle rendering are unchanged. This improvement reports absent requested background content rather than continuing with a silently black backdrop. It does not reconstruct absent assets.

counterfactual.method: Exclude only AdvData/GRP/BG/bg060_d_no.CRX from an independent read-only storage index; never rename, remove or edit original files.
counterfactual.evidence_limit: This storage experiment alone does not prove the phone file status. The separate device audit must establish whether assets were copied completely.
